recipient: Eswatini (SWZ); recipient organisation not named, recipient unspecified
title: Eswatini Client Management Information System (ECMIS)
description: TASC4 ICT Eswatini Client Management Information System is a three year technical assistance and capacity building task order that supports the Government of the Kingdom of Eswatini eGovernance unit, the Ministry of Health Strategic Information Department, Monitoring and Evaluation Department, the Government Computer Services unit of the Ministry of Information, Communication and Technology, regional health information teams, and private sector partners to develop, maintain, and use a client management information system. The CMIS is an important tool to advance the country epidemic control objectives, reach its vision of an AIDS Free Generation by 2022 and improve HIV and TB patient wellbeing. The ECMIS program continues support to the MOH to rollout and expand a national electronic medical record system to be able to better track and care for HIV positive and negative patients, give patients a comprehensive picture of their health information and consolidates and interprets data for providers and public health decision makers.
